_doc: Render-time text safety (owner 2026-11-08: 'every text in the frame viewable: not overflowing the video or cut'). Read by packages/render/src/text-safety.ts -> vN/qa/text-safety.json. Coordinates are % of the canvas (x from the left, y from the top). Zones: default per aspect, a brand entry REPLACES the zone with the same id (brand docs are the source). Exemptions remove the listed issues from matching items and are listed on the item as exempt[] with the reason. docs/gates.md.
_role_doc: owner 2026-11-08: main text (default role) keeps min_cap_height_pct 2.2; role label (small labels: round counters, rank rail sublabels, badges, chips) min 1.4. Role comes from the builder: timeline text item role, HyperFrames data-ts-role="label" on the element or an ancestor, else a brands.<brand>.roles rule (image layers that cannot carry metadata).
_layer_doc: image / alpha-video overlays on tracks whose name matches layer_tracks are checked by their painted (alpha) box over all frames: offcanvas / unsafe_margin / ui_zone only, warnings (the union box is coarse); frame-text-inspector confirms them on frames.
